_comment: SYNTHETIC table of the three money figures by product, hand-copied from the sample endorsement pack. tests/test_limits.py checks every figure against the wording itself, so this table cannot drift from the document it cites without a red test.

figures.name: policy_limit
figures.note: First stated in Endorsement No. 1; the policy schedule is not in the corpus, so no figure is offered for earlier losses.

figures.name: sub_limit
figures.source: Endorsement No. 1, clause 2 (the figure the endorsement amends 'from')
figures.note: Annual aggregate: earlier payments in the Period of Insurance erode it (clause 4.2.1); paid-to-date is not held here.

figures.name: sub_limit
figures.note: Annual aggregate across all insured locations, and part of (not additional to) the policy limit. Earlier payments erode it (clause 4.2.1); paid-to-date is not held here.

figures.name: deductible
figures.note: Applies at a location within a Flood Zone (Zone 2 or 3 on the Environment Agency map at the endorsement's inception, clause 1.2).

figures.name: deductible
figures.source: Endorsement No. 1, clause 3 (the standard property deductible 'continues to apply')
figures.note: At all locations outside a Flood Zone.

figures.name: deductible
figures.source: Endorsement No. 1, clause 3 (the standard property deductible)
figures.note: The endorsement names this as the standard property deductible; that it governs perils other than flood is an inference -- the policy schedule is not in the corpus.
